## Verdad actual

La sintesis vigente despues de auditar v38 y v39/PyEPO es simple:

- El CRPTO IJDS activo es una auditoria retrospectiva de identificacion. No
  selecciona learner, ventana residual, taxonomia, gamma, ruler, coordenada,
  cap, comparador o policy.
- Los artefactos locales previos de CRPTO son procedencia legacy y no definen la
  superficie externa actual.
- Paper 4 conserva un laboratorio secuencial exploratorio, no un protocolo de
  seleccion o despliegue.
- El capitulo Quarto contiene solo evidencia acotada y claim-safe.
- El notebook vivo contiene las olas, pendientes, bloqueos e iteraciones.

## Sintesis paper-facing

Si Paper 4 se extrae como manuscrito completo, el cuerpo debe ser corto:
tesis, arquitectura, claims permitidos y contribuciones. El detalle de cleanup,
Lab 4, metricas binder y la auditoria negativa de Paper 2 pertenece al registro
apendice renderizado en `19cb-v38-appendix-registers.qmd`.

| Bloque | Superficie paper-facing | Evidencia |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tesis | Paper 4 como governed sequential credit decision analytics | [propuesta 19a](19a-proposal-and-scope.qmd) |
| Arquitectura | external CRPTO identification contract -> negative IFRS9/SICR audit -> tail diagnostic -> source governance -> dynamic stress -> parked lanes | [tabla de arquitectura](../../../reports/paper_material/paper4/tables/paper4_one_page_architecture_2026-05-18.csv) |
| Claims | allowed/prohibited claims con fronteras verificables | [fronteras vigentes](../../../reports/paper_material/paper4/tables/paper4_current_claim_boundaries.csv) |
| Evidencia acotada | F03/F04/F05/F06/F11/F12/F13 con sus fronteras | [hallazgos vigentes](../../../reports/paper_material/paper4/tables/paper4_current_official_findings.csv) |
| Appendices | cleanup, Lab 4, metricas binder, negative Paper 2 audit | [registro 19cb](19cb-v38-appendix-registers.qmd) |

Esta separacion evita que la prosa procedural del laboratorio opaque el paper.
El cuerpo cuenta la contribucion; los appendices sostienen trazabilidad.

## Taxonomia canonica de estados

Para que Paper 4 no parezca una coleccion de parches, todo hallazgo debe usar
una taxonomia corta y estable. La
[tabla canonica de estados](../../../reports/paper_material/paper4/tables/paper4_status_taxonomy_2026-05-18.csv)
conserva los codigos; esta pagina solo muestra la lectura paper-facing.

| Estado | Uso editorial | Regla |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `official` | claim estable para cuerpo o sintesis | requiere artefacto retenido y guardrail |
| `official_with_caveat` / `official_with_boundary` | claim estable cuyo limite es parte del resultado | no citar sin la frase de frontera |
| `bounded_experiment` / `diagnostic_only` | experimento util pero acotado | appendix; no seleccion ni claim causal/regulatorio |
| `diagnostic_negative_audit` | evidencia de por que un estimando o protocolo no esta identificado | conservar como failure analysis; nunca como resultado positivo o monetario |
| `append` / `append_strong` | evidencia de soporte | appendix fuerte o respuesta de reviewer |
| `proxy_only` | source/fairness/governance sin atributos protegidos | no fair-lending legal claim |
| `rollout_only` / `isolated_prototype` | simulacion o prototipo fuera del pipeline principal | no Bellman optimality ni superioridad DFL |
| `park` / `context` / `supersede_near_term` | idea util, bloqueada o absorbida | no reabrir sin datos, prueba formal o revision externa |
| `parked_non_citable` | artefacto historico conservado solo como procedencia | no citar cifras ni reactivar claims sin protocolo nuevo |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| The active external CRPTO IJDS paper is an identification audit with no selected learner or policy. | True | External context only; local legacy artifacts cannot define current CRPTO claims. | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| The v31 artifact materializes paired processes under one internal simulator. | True | Execution and provenance only; not forecast validity or external robustness. | 19t-multi-period-solver.qmd |
| The preselected CVaR configuration dominates externally. | False | Conditional simulator diagnostic only; no external probability or policy selection. | 19i-regret-auditability-frontier.qmd |

| Paper 4 outcome endpoints or mechanical scenario calculations identify PD, ECL, SICR, staging or allowance uncertainty. | False | Binary-outcome coverage and software arithmetic cannot be relabelled as accounting estimands. | 19b-current-assets-and-gaps.qmd |
| Paper 4 retains archived Paper 2 artifacts only as a negative estimand audit. | True | Non-citable provenance only; no prudential, threshold or monetary inference. | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| Paper 2 remains a required near-term standalone publication. | False | Paper 2 is parked unless stronger contractual servicing and macro scenario data appear. | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| A legacy-root calibrated model improves over an origin-time FICO proxy in an archived diagnostic. | True | Historical appendix only; no inference about current CRPTO or legal fair lending. | 19cb-v38-appendix-registers.qmd |
| PyEPO is executable as a top-k teacher-cost benchmark. | True | Descriptive teacher-regret only; no realized loss, matched-class attribution or independent inference. | 19cc-v39-pyepo-real-suite.qmd |
| PyEPO establishes current CRPTO policy performance or selected-set coverage. | False | The legacy candidate diagnostic is separate from sampled PyEPO decisions and current CRPTO. | 19cc-v39-pyepo-real-suite.qmd |
| CATE policy value is ready for decision selection. | False | Causal diagnostics only; no policy-value claim. | 19b-current-assets-and-gaps.qmd |
| Fair-lending legal claim is supported. | False | Proxy/source governance only; no protected-attribute legal claim. | 19n-online-mdcp-fairness.qmd |

## Donde quedo el detalle

El detalle operativo ya no vive en esta sintesis. Queda separado en
`19cb-v38-appendix-registers.qmd`, con registros de cleanup, auditoria de datos,
cierre frontier, auditoria negativa de Paper 2, metricas crediticias, Lab 4 y stop rules.

La decision editorial es tratar Paper 4 como arquitectura academica de decision
secuencial gobernada, no como sistema de seleccion, IFRS9 contractual,
fair-lending, causalidad o despliegue. CRPTO permanece externo y autocontenido;
Paper 4 conserva la frontera entre laboratorio, diagnostico, apendice y claims
prohibidos.
